actions.name: Veto

Keep the sign face readable to camera, entirely inside the cell; placard at shoulder level. No lettering.

actions.name: Carimbaço — quatro contatos
poses: strong windup, right stamp lifted behind head
FIRST downward stamp strike at chest height

SECOND contact: strong horizontal stamp strike at chest height, elbow still slightly BENT, stamp and every fingertip end at most 80 percent across this cell, with a wide clear right border. Do not extend the stamp to or beyond the square cell boundary.
THIRD downward stamp strike, knees driven forward
FOURTH and final powerful low-forward stamp slam, wide planted stance
pull stamp back and recover guard

actions.name: Lei Seca de Gente — três contatos
poses: gather authority, stamp at chest and left palm open
cast left hand forward issuing command, right stamp poised
FIRST contact: forceful stamp command downward in front
SECOND contact: right stamp chops horizontally at chest height

THIRD FINAL IMPACT: body in a deep wide planted stance, torso bent strongly forward, stamp-holding arm drives DOWN and FORWARD, stamp base contacting an imaginary surface at knee height ahead of the body. Stamp MUST be BELOW the waist at the moment of impact, NOT raised overhead. Free hand counterbalances behind.
recover slowly, stamp lowered, smug stern expression

actions.name: Cerca dupla turbinada
poses: FIRST command: left hand points down nearby
SECOND command: left hand points farther forward with strong lean
withdraw pointing arm and lift stamp

actions.name: A Pergunta — dano emocional
